title: CY50103: Polymer Chemistry
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: NilIntroductory concepts, definitions, classification,
nomenclature and architecture of polymers, molecular weight and its
determination, basic aspects of step-growth and chain-growth polymerization,
free-radical, ionic, condensation polymerization, copolymerization,
stereochemistry, chemical modification of polymers, characterization of
polymers, polymer solution, relevant aspects of polymer structure, physical
properties of polymer systems, degradation and stabilization of polymer
systems, introduction to biopolymers.Books: Polymers: Chemistry Physics of
Modern Materials, 2nd edition, by J. M. G. Cowie; N. Thornes, 1991;
Introduction to Polymers, 2nd edition, by R. J. Young and P. A. Lovell, Chapman
and Hall, 1991.
